findings.current: Don’t go telling people how to run their own territory.
findings.defect: Changes a complaint about making demands in someone else’s territory into one about directing its governance.
findings.rationale: 감 내놔라, 배 내놔라 evokes demanding one thing after another.
findings.replacement: Don’t go demanding this and that in someone else’s territory.
findings.source: 남의 구역에서 감 내놔라, 배 내놔라 하지 마라.

findings.current: Of course, there was one person who kept watching the whole scene without so much as twitching an eyebrow.
findings.defect: Omits the contrast with the preceding sentence: unlike the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, this person did not back down.
findings.rationale: 아니었지만 makes this watcher the exception to having to retreat.
findings.replacement: But not the one who had watched it all without so much as twitching an eyebrow.
findings.source: 물론, 또 눈썹 하나 까딱하지 않은 채 이 모든 광경을 지켜보던 누군가는 아니었지만.

findings.current: In a courtyard surrounded by perpetual snow, what mosquito was going to freeze to death?
findings.defect: Treats 마당에 as a physical courtyard and 얼어 죽을 as a claim that a mosquito would freeze, losing the narrator’s dismissive punchline.
findings.rationale: 마당에 means ‘given the circumstances’ here; 얼어 죽을 emphatically dismisses the idea of a mosquito.
findings.replacement: With perennial snow on the ground, what damn mosquito?
findings.source: 만년설(萬年雪)이 끼어 있는 마당에 모기는 무슨 얼어 죽을.

findings.current: “With you here beside us, what could an army of a thousand matter to us?”
findings.defect: Makes the army sound like a threat they can withstand rather than a force they do not need because Jeok is with them.
findings.rationale: 천군만마가 대수겠습니까 credits the senior’s presence as worth an army.
findings.replacement: “With you here beside us, who needs an army?”
findings.source: 저희야 노선배께서 함께 계시니, 천군만마가 대수겠습니까.

findings.current: Jeok Cheongang seemed less than pleased. He glanced at me with a frown and spoke.
findings.defect: Presents his frown as sincere displeasure rather than a deliberate show.
findings.rationale: 짐짓 marks the frown as affected.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang looked at me, put on a frown, and spoke.
findings.source: 나를 보며 짐짓 눈살을 찌푸린 적천강이 입을 열었다.

findings.current: The meeting wrapped up in less than fifteen minutes.
findings.defect: Makes fifteen minutes the meeting’s total duration instead of the time remaining after this exchange.
findings.rationale: 그 후 and 더 both specify additional time.
findings.replacement: After that, the meeting wrapped up in less than another fifteen minutes.
findings.source: 그 후, 회의는 불과 일각도 더 이어지지 않고 마무리되었다.

findings.current: “Of course. I suddenly needed to take a piss, so I didn’t hear him out.”
findings.defect: Turns Jeok’s euphemism into explicit profanity.
findings.rationale: 소피 is a restrained euphemism for urination, not the blunt equivalent of ‘take a piss.’
findings.replacement: “Of course. I suddenly had to relieve myself, so I didn’t hear him out.”

summary: Several lines alter the nature of the dispute, the timing of the meeting, or a speaker’s register; others lose pointed characterization.
